raw.content_en: The US Department of Commerce (BIS) rescinded the Biden-era firearms rule, restoring prior export control treatment for civilian firearms, ammunition, and parts. For China exporters of firearms, ammunition, optics, and related components to the US market, this reduces certain licensing burdens but does not eliminate core obligations: items remain subject to the US export control regime, and re-export of US-origin firearms technology or components from China requires continued compliance. Exporters should re-verify classification under the revised controls, confirm whether items move from the USML to the EAR or vice versa, and maintain end-user/end-use documentation. Section 301 tariffs and HTS alignment still apply to many firearm-related goods, and Entity List screening remains mandatory for all parties in the transaction.
raw.content_zh: 美国商务部（BIS）撤销了拜登时期的枪支规则，恢复了对民用枪支、弹药及零部件的原有出口管制待遇。对于向美国市场出口枪支、弹药、光学器件及相关部件的中国出口商而言，这减少了部分许可负担，但并未消除核心义务：相关物项仍受美国出口管制制度约束，从中国再出口美国原产枪支技术或部件仍需持续合规。出口商应重新核实修订后管制措施下的分类，确认物项是否从USML转入EAR或反之，并保留最终用户/最终用途文件。301关税和HTS归类仍适用于许多枪支相关商品，且交易各方仍必须进行实体清单筛查。

checklist.task: Re-classify under revised BIS firearms controls
checklist.desc: Confirm whether each firearm, ammunition, or part is controlled under the EAR or USML after the rule rescission; document ECCN or USML category and retain classification records.

checklist.task: Entity List and restricted party screening
checklist.desc: Screen all US consignees, brokers, and end users against the BIS Entity List, SDN list, and denied persons lists before shipment; retain screening evidence.
Map each item to the 10-digit HTS line, check Section 301 List coverage and additional duty rates, and document country of origin and value build-up.
Obtain and retain signed end-user/end-use certificates for firearms and controlled components; verify no diversion to restricted end uses.
For electronic optics, sights, and accessories, confirm FCC Part 15/18 compliance and supplier FCC IDs before US entry.
Review contracts for US-origin content and include re-export control clauses; ensure China-side re-export of US-origin firearms technology complies with BIS rules.
